name: @quereus/plugin-loader
description: Plugin loading system for Quereus - supports dynamic imports for Node.js and browsers
//typesVersions: NOTE: consumers still compile with moduleResolution 'node' (node10), which ignores the exports map above. typesVersions is how the './node' subpath's types resolve for them; drop it once every consumer moves to node16/bundler resolution.

scripts.//typecheck: NOTE: the second pass type-checks test/ too (tsconfig.json only includes src/). vitest transpiles specs without checking them, so without this a signature change in src/ would leave the specs silently stale.
scripts.//test: NOTE: test/ covers url validation + the loader's protocol allowlist, npm-spec parsing, CDN url building, env detection, loadPlugin dispatch, config interpolation/validation, the config channel, and https:// module loads through the Node remote resolver (with fetch injected, so no test touches the network). Known gaps (both need network or a DOM): the manifest fetch from a plugin's package.json, and the real browser+CDN load path. --passWithNoTests is deliberately NOT set, so a glob that stops matching fails loudly instead of reporting green.
